libraries.jose: signs JWTs (RS256): the GitHub App's for the novels repository and the Google service account's; site-runtime's ./access only verifies Access tokens
libraries.mdast-util-directive: the editor's Markdown round trip (app/lib/editor/markdown.mjs) parses and writes source back; Prelum renders to HTML and never writes Markdown
libraries.mdast-util-from-markdown: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above
libraries.mdast-util-frontmatter: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above
libraries.mdast-util-gfm: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above
libraries.mdast-util-math: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-directive: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-frontmatter: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-gfm: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above
libraries.micromark-extension-math: the editor's Markdown round trip, as above

copies.app/lib/editor/markdown.mjs: kindOf here names a Markdown source block's label (front matter, code, table), not site-api's media kind
copies.app/lib/novels/layout.ts: kindOf here names a book file's kind from its path (scene, character, outline), not site-api's media kind
copies.app/lib/people.server.ts: kindOf here names a project's kind (site or book), not site-api's media kind
copies.app/lib/sites.server.ts: siteEntry here is Carrel's connection entry for a site (its origin and key from the Worker's secrets, the Search Console property), not site-runtime's public registry entry
copies.public/_headers: not by hand: site-runtime-headers writes it on every build from the registry entry the Worker's set comes from (npm run headers, carrel-desk); committed so the /assets/* cache rule can be read
